description: Eight-track sequencer, each track up to 64 steps, with a gate, a pitch and two CV outputs per track and eight patterns stored

params.text: Turns the trig on that step of the selected track on or off, and selects that trig so the trig controls below edit it
Silences that track, leaving it running
Selects that track, so the track and trig controls edit it
Chooses which quarter of the 64 steps the sixteen step buttons show
Turns fill on, which plays the trigs whose probability is set to FILL and silences those set to !FILL
Starts and stops the sequencer
Sets the octave of the selected trig's pitch
Sets the note of the selected trig's pitch within the octave
Chooses which of the eight patterns is played and edited
Sets how many steps the selected track runs, 1 to 64
Steps through the five ways the track is read — forwards, backwards, ping-pong, random, and random neighbour
Multiplies the clock the selected track runs at, 1 to 4 times
Slides the pitch of the selected trig towards the one before it, none at one end and the whole step at the other
Picks what the selected trig's gate is made of: the sequencer's own gate, or the signal at the GTE1 or GTE2 input
Moves the selected trig earlier or later within its step, up to a whole step either way
Sets how long the selected trig's gate stays open, 0 to 64 steps
Sets how many pulses the selected trig fires, 0 to 64
Sets how far apart those pulses are, 0 to 64 steps
Sets the voltage the selected trig sends from one of the track's two CV outputs, -10V to +10V
Picks the test the selected trig must pass to play: a dice roll, a count of passes, fill on or off, the trig before it having played or not, or the same step on the next track having played or not
Sets how many passes the counted probability lets the trig play for, 1 to 100
Sets how many passes go by before that count starts again, 1 to 100
Records the gate and pitch arriving at the record inputs onto the selected track as it runs
Quantizes what is recorded to the selected track's root note and scale
Sets the root note the selected track's pitches are quantized to
Sets the scale the selected track's pitches are quantized to
Quantizes the selected track's CV1 output to the same scale as its pitch output
Switches the selected trig's slide between sliding in and sliding out

inputs.text: The clock the sequencer runs on
A trigger here sends every track back to its first step
A trigger here sends that track back to its first step
The signal that trigs set to that gate type send from the gate output in place of the sequencer's own gate
0V to 10V chooses which of the eight patterns is played
A gate here silences that track for as long as it is held
Turns fill on, which plays the trigs whose probability is set to FILL and silences those set to !FILL
The gate recorded onto the selected track while recording is on
The pitch recorded onto the selected track while recording is on

outputs.text: The gate of that track, at whatever length and pulse count its trigs are set to
The pitch of that track, a volt per octave, quantized to its root note and scale
The CV set for the current trig of that track, -10V to +10V; the CV1 column can be quantized to the track's scale with the switch and the CV2 column never is

notes: the sequencer comes up stopped, and it is stopped again every time the patch is loaded, so press RUN to start it
shift-click a step button to turn its trig on or off without selecting it for editing
the copy, paste, erase and randomize items are keys as well: hold the pointer over a step, track or page button, or the PTRN knob, and press the letter printed beside the item
menu: Add expander — places a zOù MAï Expander in the rack immediately to the right
Trig — a submenu acting on the selected trig, holding Erase, Copy, Paste, Rand Note, Rand Note+, Rand Prob, Full Rand, Rand CV1, Rand CV2, Move Up and Move Down
Track — a submenu acting on the selected track, holding the slide mode item, Erase, Copy, Paste, Rand, Rand Notes, Rand Notes+, Rand Probs, Rand CV1, Rand CV2, the Move items and a Label field
Slide time/rate const. — the slide mode item on the Track submenu; time constant gives the track's slides one time whatever the interval, rate constant makes a wider interval take longer
Pattern — a submenu acting on the whole pattern, holding Erase, Copy, Paste, Rand and Full Rand
Page — a submenu acting on the sixteen steps of the page on show, holding Erase, Copy, Paste, Rand Notes, Rand Notes+, Rand Probs, Rand CV1 and Rand CV2
Move Up — on the Trig submenu it lifts the selected trig's note by a semitone, and on the Track submenu it lifts every note on the track
Move Down — on the Trig submenu it drops the selected trig's note by a semitone, and on the Track submenu it drops every note on the track
Move Left — on the Track submenu, rotates the track's trigs one step earlier
Move Right — on the Track submenu, rotates the track's trigs one step later
Label — on the Track submenu, a text field naming the selected track on the display
